correctness.rationale: The full positive-integer classification is proved by Vieta descent. The coefficient \(K\) is integral after coprimality is established; the other root \(r=\Phi_6(a)/b\) is a positive integer below \(a\), and the endpoint \(r=1\) also contradicts \(a>1\). Both congruences survive because \(\Phi_6(1-z)=\Phi_6(z)\). The semiprime consequence follows from the exact identity \(n\mathcal H(n)=\prod_{p^e\parallel n}(p^{2e+1}+1)/(p+1)\).
